text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 32, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "32 forwards"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 80, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "80 guards"}], "plan": [{"op": "div", "args": ["q2", "q1"], "out": "s1", "note": "floor(80/32) for the Euclidean step"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s1", "q1"], "out": "s2", "note": "s1 * 32"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q2", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "remainder of 80 divided by 32"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q1", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "floor(32/remainder) for the next Euclidean step"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s4", "s3"], "out": "s5", "note": "s4 * remainder"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "s5"], "out": "s6", "note": "next remainder (0 confirms s3 is the greatest common divisor)"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q2", "s3"], "out": "s7", "note": "guards per team = total guards / greatest number of teams"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "number of guards on each team when Leo forms the greatest possible number of equal teams"}, "dismissed": []}
